summary_en: Wisdom Inc., an acquisition vehicle established by Watami's CEO Hideki Watanabe and related parties, has initiated a tender offer to acquire all outstanding shares of Watami Co., Ltd. (code 7522) to take the company private. The offer targets shares excluding restricted stock awards and treasury shares, with the acquirer already holding approximately 28.6% of voting shares through related entities.
title_en: Notice Regarding Commencement of Tender Offer for Shares of Watami Co., Ltd. (Securities Code: 7522) by Wisdom Inc.
translation_en_brief: Wisdom Inc., a special acquisition vehicle established on October 2, 2026, announced the commencement of a tender offer for all ordinary shares of Watami Co., Ltd. on November 13, 2026. The transaction constitutes a management buyout (MBO) aimed at taking the company private. Wisdom is controlled by Hideki Watanabe, CEO and Representative Director, Chairman & President of Watami, and Masaya Watanabe, an executive officer of Watami, through an asset management company. The acquirer and related entities, including Inuizai Itten Co., Ltd., already own approximately 28.57% of Watami's shares (11.46 million shares, calculated against 40.11 million shares outstanding excluding treasury stock as of September 30, 2026). The tender offer targets all shares except restricted stock awards granted to directors, non-director executive officers, and employees, as well as Watami's own treasury shares. Hideki Watanabe is expected to continue as CEO and Representative Director, Chairman & President following completion of the transaction. The company also publicly disclosed Watanabe's personal statement regarding the transaction on the same date.
